mcq_types.name: standard_mcq
mcq_types.description: Single-best-answer multiple choice question with four options.

mcq_types.name: assertion_reason
mcq_types.description: Assertion and reason pair with a single correct conclusion based on the relationship between the statements.

mcq_types.name: statement_based_2
mcq_types.description: Two-statement evaluation question where the student selects the correct logical relationship or conclusion.

mcq_types.name: statement_based_3
mcq_types.description: Three-statement evaluation question with analysis of correctness and interdependence.

mcq_types.name: statement_based_4
mcq_types.description: Four-statement evaluation question requiring logical synthesis across multiple propositions.

mcq_types.name: statement_based_multi
mcq_types.description: Multi-statement evaluation question where several statements must be assessed together to determine the correct answer.

mcq_types.name: match_list
mcq_types.description: Matching or list-based question where entries from two lists are paired or arranged correctly.

mcq_types.name: diagram_image
mcq_types.description: Question based on a diagram, image, chart, graph, ray diagram, circuit, or visual representation.

mcq_types.name: sequencing
mcq_types.description: Question requiring ordering of events, steps, reactions, stages, or processes in the correct chronological or logical sequence.

mcq_types.name: numerical
mcq_types.description: Numerical problem requiring quantitative reasoning, calculation, and final value selection.

mcq_types.name: multiple_correct
mcq_types.description: Question with more than one correct option, where the candidate must identify all valid answers according to the exam rule.
